name: Cargosol Logistics Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2011, Cargosol Logistics Ltd is a full-service freight forwarder catering to domestic and International transportation requirements[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
CLPL provides freight forwarding services, Logistics and Shipping Services for both inbound and outbound shipments to domestic 
and international territory. These services are related to the carriage handling, packing or distribution of goods or warehousing.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 0.09% over last 3 years.
